==¶ The Goſpel according to S.Iohn.==

==={{Chapter|1|CHAP. I.}}===
{{smaller block|[[#1:1|1]] The Diuinitie, Humanitie, and Office of Ieſus Chriſt. [[#1:15|15]] The teſtimonie of Iohn. [[#1:39|39]] The calling of Andrew, Peter, &c.}}

{{Verse|1|1|notext=}}{{dropinitial|I|image=King James Bible (1611) page A2v (I).png|imgsize=100px}}N the beginning was the Word, ⁊ the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

{{Verse|1|2}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Gen.1.1.}} The ſame was in the beginning with God.

{{Verse|1|3}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Col.1.16.}} All things were made by him, and without him was not any thing made that was made.

{{Verse|1|4}} In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

{{Verse|1|5}} And the light ſhineth in darkneſſe, and the darkneſſe comprehended it not.

{{Verse|1|6}} ¶ *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Mat.3.1.}} There was a man ſent from God, whoſe name {{smaller|was}} Iohn. 

{{Verse|1|7}} The ſame came for a witneſſe, to beare witneſſe of the light, that all {{smaller|men}} through him might beleeue.

{{Verse|1|8}} Hee was not that light, but {{smaller|was ſent}} to beare witneſſe of that light.

{{Verse|1|9}} {{smaller|That}} was the true light, which lighteth euery man that commeth into the world.

{{Verse|1|10}} Hee was in the world, and *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Heb.11.3.}} the world was made by him, and the world knew him not.

{{Verse|1|11}} Hee came vnto his owne, and his owne receiued him not.

{{Verse|1|12}} But as many receiued him, to them gaue hee ǁ{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=ǁ ''Or, the right or priuilegde.''}} power to become the ſonnes of God, {{smaller|euen}} to them that beleeue on his Name:

{{Verse|1|13}} Which were borne, not of blood, nor of the will of the fleſh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

{{Verse|1|14}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Mar.1.16}} And the Word was made fleſh, and dwelt among vs (⁊ we beheld his glory, the glory as of the onely begotten of the Father) full of grace and trueth.

{{Verse|1|15}} ¶ John bare witneſſe of him, and cried, ſaying, this was he of whom I ſpake, he that commeth after me, is preferred before me, for he was before me.

{{Verse|1|16}} And of his *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* Col.1.19.}} fulneſſe haue all wee receiued, and grace for grace.

{{Verse|1|17}} For the Law was giuen by Moſes, {{smaller|but}} grace and trueth came by Ieſus Chriſt.

{{Verse|1|18}} *{{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text-align=left|text=* 1.Iohn 4.12. 1.tim.6.16.}} No man hath ſeene God at any time: the onely begotten Sonne, which is in the boſome of the Father, he hath declared {{smaller|him}}.

{{Verse|1|19}} ¶ And this is the record of Iohn, when the Iewes ſent Prieſts and Leuites from Hieruſalem, to aſke him, Who art thou?

{{Verse|1|20}} And he confeſſed, and denied not: but confeſſed, I am not the Chriſt.
